verdict.rationale: Square has a documented Disputes API ("Process Disputes") covering dispute lifecycle, and Webhooks docs suggest event-based notification is possible, but the evidence pack doesn't explicitly confirm merchant-ops-facing chargeback alerts or a concrete dashboard workflow for submitting evidence before deadlines. missing for 10: explicit documentation of chargeback notification triggers/deadlines, dashboard UI evidence for evidence submission, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the dispute workflow.
